geometry.gimbal_stop_support: lower x stop throughout; unilateral stop strength unvalidated

reference_collision_audit.scope: Actual task collision masks/pairs; disabled visual/chassis geometry excluded; no dynamics steps

known_unresolved_regression.reason: Archived a80 ground-to-wall clip still uses pre-CAD asset kinematics; separate reference not retargeted in this task

limitations: No physics steps, policy execution or training
Static necessary-condition relaxation: only engaged passive gimbals balanced; free swinging gimbals and acceleration excluded
SLSQP nonconvex local solution: a failure is not proof that all allocations are impossible
Equal median unit quantiles are a characteristic audit, not median pad capacity
IID survival fractions are model estimates on fixed reference-derived loads, not observed reliability
120 N total seating gate is an unvalidated uniform 12x10 N approximation; seeded mature contacts bypass seating
Fixed-reference IID holding fractions are low; no stochastic robustness acceptance
Full-pad hardware protocol only prepared, not executed
